name: External File Change Detection
description: Detect when files in workspace storage change outside of Tribunus control. Sources include: git pull, external editor saves, file sync tools, build tools, and other processes. On detection, reindex affected files and reconcile workspace state. Implement filesystem watchers and periodic full scans.
purpose: Workspace state becomes inconsistent when files change externally. Unreconciled changes cause stale analysis, incorrect dirty-state, and phantom artifacts. Real-time detection with reconciliation keeps workspace state accurate regardless of how files are modified.
acceptanceCriteria: Filesystem watchers detect creation, modification, and deletion of tracked files
Git pull and checkout operations trigger workspace reindexing
External editor saves are detected and files are reconciled
Periodic full scan catches changes missed by watchers (configurable interval)
Changes detected outside Tribunus update workspace dirty-state and artifact freshness
File change events are debounced to avoid thrashing on bulk operations
Reindexing is scoped to affected files, not workspace-wide
Reconciliation is logged and visible in workspace history
